stem.en: A party has lost a general election and is now the opposition. What is its work until the next election?

text.en: It has no work at all until the next election is called
It shares in forming the government with the winning party
It decides the country's policies and puts them into practice
It ensures accountability, in debates and committees

explanation.en: The winning party forms the government and makes policy. The opposition has work of its own: it ensures accountability and takes part in debates and committees.

hints.en: Two paths come after the result. Which one is the opposition's?
